description: Prepare a leveraged loop: the loan buys more of the pledged token in one transaction. USDG only. Refused above maxCostBps. Returns the next unsigned transaction and a review link; never signs.

lendAsset.description: USDG only: leverage lends USDG (a loop in a lend asset is refused)

maxCostBps.description: Highest loan cost you accept, bps of the amount borrowed; the loop is refused above it

multiple.description: Leverage, 1.1 to 3 with at most two decimals (2 = twice the pledge held for the loan)

own.description: The tokens you put in, raw units

term.description: Loan term in seconds, one of the terms gage_capabilities lists

name: gage_prepare_leverage
title: Prepare: Open a loop
